description: This file defines the implementation of the DobbySpecGenerator class, which generates container runtime specifications for applications, including configuration of mounts, environment variables, plugins, and resource limits. It is part of a plugin namespace within the WPEFramework project and interacts with various system components and external libraries such as curl.

classes.name: DobbySpecGenerator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating container specifications for applications, including configuration of mounts, environment variables, plugins, and resource limits.

methods.name: getWorkingDir
methods.description: Returns the working directory for the application, defaulting to the package mount point.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a container specification JSON based on application and runtime configurations, optionally reading from a pre-existing spec file.

methods.name: createEnvVars
methods.description: Creates environment variable array for the container based on application and runtime configurations.

methods.name: createMounts
methods.description: Creates an array of mount configurations for the container, including app path, runtime path, SSL certs, and resource mounts.

methods.name: createBindMount
methods.description: Creates a bind mount configuration with specified source, destination, and mount flags.

methods.name: shouldEnableGpu
methods.description: Determines if GPU should be enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: getSysMemoryLimit
methods.description: Calculates the system memory limit for the container based on configuration.

methods.name: getGPUMemoryLimit
methods.description: Calculates the GPU memory limit for the container based on configuration.

methods.name: getVpuEnabled
methods.description: Checks if VPU (Video Processing Unit) should be enabled for the application.

methods.name: getCpuCores
methods.description: Returns a string representing the CPU cores to assign to the container.

methods.name: createRdkPlugins
methods.description: Creates a set of RDK plugins for the container, including networking, ion memory, and other capabilities.

methods.name: createMinidumpPlugin
methods.description: Creates configuration for minidump plugin for crash reporting.

methods.name: createAppServiceSDKPlugin
methods.description: Creates configuration for the App Service SDK plugin.

methods.name: createNetworkPlugin
methods.description: Creates network plugin configuration, including NAT or none types.

methods.name: populateClassicPlugins
methods.description: Populates the container specification with classic plugins such as logging and DRM.

methods.name: createEthanLogPlugin
methods.description: Creates configuration for the EthanLog plugin for logging.

methods.name: createMulticastSocketPlugin
methods.description: Placeholder for multicast socket plugin configuration (not supported).

methods.name: createIonMemoryPlugin
methods.description: Creates ion memory plugin configuration.

methods.name: createThunderPlugin
methods.description: Creates configuration for the Thunder plugin with local service URLs.

methods.name: createOpenCDMPlugin
methods.description: Creates configuration for the OpenCDM plugin.

methods.name: initialiseIonHeapsJson
methods.description: Initializes ion heap configurations for the ion memory plugin.

methods.name: createPrivateDataMount
methods.description: Creates a private data mount configuration.

methods.name: createFkpsMounts
methods.description: Creates FKPS file mounts and additional tmpfs mount for DRM.

methods.name: createTmpfsMount
methods.description: Creates a tmpfs mount configuration.

methods.name: createResourceManagerMount
methods.description: Creates a resource manager socket mount.

methods.name: encodeURL
methods.description: Encodes a URL string using libcurl.
